findings.title: Clipped and low-contrast instruction bars
findings.where: Arena, Road, and City screens, top-center instruction/status bar
findings.problem: The instruction bars use small, light grey text on a semi-transparent background; long lines are truncated with an ellipsis, making controls and status messages unreadable.
findings.why: Players can’t see critical control hints or journey status at a glance, leading to confusion and missed information during play.
findings.fix: Increase font size by 20%, switch to bold white text, expand the container width or enable multi-line wrapping, remove ellipses, and boost the background opacity to at least 80% for better contrast.

findings.title: Static radar display
findings.where: Bottom-left radar panel on Arena, Road, and City screens
findings.problem: Radar shows a static green circle with no sweep animation or blip markers; the orientation label is truncated and cut off.
findings.why: Players expect dynamic scanning feedback to track enemies or waypoints; a non-animating, featureless radar undermines trust in this instrument.
findings.fix: Implement a rotating sweep line with a fading trail, render pulsing blips for detected objects, and adjust the panel layout so the full "Orientation: north-up" text fits beneath the radar.

findings.title: Invisible progress bar
findings.where: Road screen, top-center just below the status bar
findings.problem: The trip progress bar is a thin line with minimal contrast against the background, and its fill indicator is nearly the same shade, making progress almost imperceptible.
findings.why: Players can’t gauge how far they've driven or how much remains, reducing the sense of progression and anticipation.
findings.fix: Increase the bar height to at least 8px, use a distinct high-contrast fill color (e.g., bright teal) and a darker grey track, and add a percentage readout at the right end.

findings.title: Subtle menu selection highlight
findings.where: Title screen, central menu box around options
findings.problem: The selected menu item is outlined with a thin neon border while unselected items are plain text, making the active choice ambiguous.
findings.why: New players may not clearly see which menu option is active, hindering navigation and giving the UI an unfinished feel.
findings.fix: Use a solid background fill for the selected row in a contrasting color, increase padding, change the selected font color to white, and add a hover state (e.g., slight background tint) for unselected items.

findings.title: Unstructured constructor layout
findings.where: Constructor screen, left component list and right stats/preview panel
findings.problem: All elements appear as plain text in narrow columns with minimal spacing or separators; the name input, section headers, weapon slots, and help text all bleed together.
findings.why: Players struggle to distinguish stats vs. equipment slots vs. instructions, increasing cognitive load and slowing down vehicle setup.
findings.fix: Group related controls under bold, labeled headers with horizontal dividers, enclose the name input in a clearly labeled box with a thicker border, add simple icons for body/chassis/weapon slots, and increase footer help text to at least 14px.
